recommendations.title: Increase Daily Budget to ₱500 and Maintain Consistent Delivery
recommendations.detail: The account's historical patchy performance (frequent days of ₱0 spend) is severely hurting Meta's optimization algorithm. Increase the daily budget from ₱250 to at least ₱500 to allow the system to exit the learning phase, and commit to running ads continuously for at least 14 days without manual pauses.
